title: NYC Private Walking Tour
blurb: Enjoy a private, customized, small-group walking tour of New York City with your local guide who knows the streets backwards and forwards and will give you an insider's perspective. Choose from a 4-hour, morning or afternoon tour, or see everything by choosing the full-day walking tour. See some of the Big Apple's most popular attractions and points of interest, like Times Square, Central Park, Midtown Manhattan, Lower Manhattan, and the iconic Brooklyn Bridge, just to name a few. A Manhattan hotel pickup and drop-off is also included if you wish so. All tour stops are totally customizable.
